meta.usp-veiligheid.html.description: What Lemnion can mean for your hotel: energy advice, subsidy guidance, charging infrastructure, smart software and tailor-made solutions.
usp-veiligheid.intro: What makes Lemnion truly different, from factory-direct distribution to certified safety. Discover why no competitor offers this complete package.
usp-veiligheid.label: The bottom line
usp-veiligheid.h2: No one does what Lemnion does
usp-veiligheid.p1: Lemnion is the only company in this market that is a factory-direct distributor with a fully integrated, programmable and safety-certified ecosystem: battery, EMS (Energy Management System), EV charging and DC-coupled solar in one platform. With parts in stock in the Netherlands.
usp-veiligheid.p2: Every other party resells third-party hardware, uses separate software packages that do not communicate, lacks the right safety certifications, or locks customers into long-term contracts with oversized systems. Lemnion does not.
usp-veiligheid.c1p: We import hardware directly from the factory | no intermediaries. Parts in stock in the Netherlands. Lead time: 2 to 4 weeks from stock. No months of waiting for containers from Asia.
usp-veiligheid.c2p: Battery + EMS + OCPP (Open Charge Point Protocol) 2.0.1 charging + 25 kW DC-coupled solar in one platform. One contract, one invoice, one phone number. Everything from a single source | no hassle with separate parties.
usp-veiligheid.c3p: The only programmable Energy Management System. No fixed profiles, no closed cloud platforms. Our engineers write strategies tailored to each location | fully aligned with your business.
usp-veiligheid.c4p: 25 kW+ MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) directly on the DC bus. No conversion losses. Maximum efficiency | every generated kilowatt-hour goes straight into your battery. No competitor offers this.
usp-veiligheid.c5p: Engineering, installation, commissioning, 24/7 monitoring, parts and support. Everything included in one transparent price. No hidden costs afterwards. What is on the quote is what you pay.
usp-veiligheid.c6p: Custom OCPP charging software, not bought in from third parties. Full control over charging sessions, load balancing and integration with the EMS. No vendor lock-in | you decide, not the charger supplier.
usp-veiligheid.vergelijk-intro: One look at this table and you see the difference. Lemnion is the only party that scores on every front.
usp-veiligheid.veiligheid-intro: Safety comes first, especially in and near hotels where guests, staff and property must be protected. That is why we apply a 6-layer safety model that goes beyond what the law requires.
usp-veiligheid.l1p: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) is the safest lithium chemistry. No thermal runaway like NMC cells. No fire hazard even when punctured.
usp-veiligheid.l2p: Every cell is continuously monitored for voltage, temperature and internal resistance. The BMS (Battery Management System) intervenes within milliseconds when deviations occur.
usp-veiligheid.l3p: Active liquid cooling instead of passive air cooling. Keeps cells at optimal temperature (20-25°C), extends lifespan and prevents hotspots.
usp-veiligheid.l4p: Aerosol extinguishing system fully integrated in the enclosure. Detects and extinguishes automatically. Tested according to UL 9540A (4th + 5th edition, cell level).
usp-veiligheid.l5p: A physical emergency stop galvanically isolates the system from the grid. Hard-wired safety circuit, no software-dependent shutdown.
usp-veiligheid.l6p: Direct connection to the building's existing fire alarm panel. On alarm: automatic shutdown + notification to the fire brigade.
usp-veiligheid.cta-h2: Ready to make your hotel safely energy independent?
